name: Barlahida (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Barlahida (a blue shield with a red-clad figure and a green mound) between the words BARLAHIDA above and KÖZSÉG ÖNKORMÁNYZATA below in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
